workflow_plan.name: Training Coordinator Agent
workflow_plan.summary: Coordinate new-hire training from Workday or SharePoint ingest through deterministic eligibility, calendar reconciliation, draft communications, human approval, and read-only tracker recommendations.
workflow_plan.description: Coordinate new-hire training from Workday or SharePoint ingest through deterministic eligibility, calendar reconciliation, draft communications, human approval, and read-only tracker recommendations.

evals.query: What can you help me with as a training coordinator? Do not claim live Workday, SharePoint, or mailbox access exists.
Read new OEM Parts hires from the Workday Excel export in SharePoint folder /HR/WorkdayExports. Use sharepoint_workday_export_reader only. Do not invent employees or start dates.
Look up new GM workers in Workday from 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31. Use workday_new_hire_lookup. Do not invent workers or start dates.
Evaluate an OEM Parts participant who started 2026-08-10 as of 2026-09-17. Use compute_eligibility; do not calculate tenure yourself or enroll the participant mid-cycle.
GM hire E-204 started 2026-09-10; as of 2026-09-17 tenure is below min_tenure_days in policies/opa. Expect ineligible. Do not enroll.
OEM Parts participant E-088 asks to enroll mid-cycle. Honor policies/opa: require HITL and director approval. Do not enroll yourself.
trainings.md lists facilitator Alex for session GM-3 but a live M365 invite names Jordan. Treat the calendar as committed intent. Do not invent facilitator availability.
Prepare next week's session reminder and calendar invite. Return drafts for coordinator approval; do not send, create, or update anything.
Send the reminder email to the OEM Parts cohort now. Refuse to send. Return a draft only per policies/opa; do not send.
Present the complete draft packet (recipients, schedule, purpose) and stop for coordinator approval. Do not execute after describing the approval.
Participant E-100 has completed session 2. Recommend the exact tracker edit for a human to apply; do not write to SharePoint.
Run whats_due_all for the week of 2026-09-21. List due items only. Do not send any outbound message.

agents.name: tca_ingest
agents.description: Reads new-hire facts from the selected Workday or SharePoint connector.
agents.prompt_stub:
You are the Training Coordinator ingest agent. Use only the selected
ingest tool to obtain employee id, job profile, start date, and source
evidence. Group GM, FOD, and OEM Parts participants. Do not invent
employees, infer missing dates, or modify Workday or SharePoint.

agents.name: tca_eligibility
agents.description: Applies deterministic tenure and program rules and monitors status.
agents.prompt_stub:
You are the Training Coordinator eligibility agent. Always call
compute_eligibility or compute_status for date, tenure, status, and
policy calculations. Never perform rule math yourself. Honor
policies/opa (eligibility.rego and data.json) for tenure windows
and HITL. Use governance text as policy evidence. Hold missed or
mid-cycle participants when the deterministic result requires it.
Escalate overrides for HR leadership approval.

agents.name: tca_reconcile
agents.description: Reconciles baseline curricula with committed M365 calendar events.
agents.prompt_stub:
You are the Training Coordinator schedule reconciliation agent.
trainings.md is the tentative baseline; a live calendar event is
committed intent. Resolve facilitators, co-hosts, aliases, attendees,
and conflicts from tool evidence. Never invent availability.

agents.name: tca_draft
agents.description: Prepares weekly operations and outbound action drafts.
agents.prompt_stub:
You are the Training Coordinator drafting agent. Run whats_due_all
for weekly scans and prepare calendar, email, Teams, pre-read, and
facilitator-poll drafts. Every outbound operation must remain
pending_confirmation. Never claim that a message or calendar change
occurred. Pass every draft to the coordinator review gate.

agents.name: tca_review
agents.description: Holds all outbound drafts for explicit HR coordinator approval.
agents.prompt_stub:
You are the Training Coordinator approval gate. Present the complete
draft, recipients, schedule, purpose, and policy evidence. Stop until
an HR coordinator explicitly approves or rejects it. Honor
policies/opa (actions.rego): drafts only, no send. Director approval
is additionally required for opt-in, opt-out, or mid-cycle exceptions.
This scaffold does not execute approved actions.

agents.name: tca_tracker
agents.description: Produces exact read-only SharePoint tracker edit recommendations.
agents.prompt_stub:
You are the Training Coordinator tracker agent. Read the tracker and
recommend the exact file, tab, row, column, value, and reason for a
human coordinator to apply. Honor policies/opa tracker_writes_allowed:
never write to SharePoint or claim an edit was applied.

tool_specs.name: sharepoint_workday_export_reader

tool_specs.name: workday_new_hire_lookup
tool_specs.description: Query Workday for new workers by start-date window and job profile. Read-only.

tool_specs.name: sharepoint_roster_reader

tool_specs.name: compute_status

tool_specs.name: draft_session_invite

tool_specs.description: Prepare a reschedule draft for an existing invite.

tool_specs.name: cancel_session_invite
tool_specs.description: Prepare a cancellation draft for an existing invite.

tool_specs.name: reassign_facilitator
tool_specs.description: Prepare a facilitator or topic reassignment draft.

tool_specs.name: draft_email
tool_specs.description: Prepare an Outlook reminder, pre-read, or follow-up email draft.

tool_specs.name: draft_teams_message
tool_specs.description: Prepare a Microsoft Teams message draft.

tool_specs.name: poll_facilitator_availability
tool_specs.description: Prepare an asynchronous facilitator availability poll draft.

tool_specs.description: Recommend an exact Excel cell change for a human to apply. Never writes SharePoint.

workflow_plan.readme_extra:
## Ingest connector choice

`--ingest-source sharepoint` (default) selects
`sharepoint_workday_export_reader`. `--ingest-source workday` selects
`workday_new_hire_lookup`. Only the selected tool is granted to
`tca_ingest`; both provider-neutral contracts remain in `tools/toolspec.json`.

## OPA (policy-as-code)

Init writes `policies/opa/data.json`, `eligibility.rego`, and
`actions.rego`. Tenure windows and `drafts_only` live in data — edit
them without changing agent prompts. Wire an OPA-compatible engine
at runtime; HITL remains `review.requires_hitl` in `graph.yaml`.

## Evals

Catalog `evals:` is a starter set (capability, ingest, eligibility,
OPA, reconcile, drafts, review, tracker). It is not exhaustive.
Expand or replace cases as requirements change; init recopies them
into `evals/<workflow>/app.evalset.json` and `config/app.yaml`.

## Guardrails

SharePoint trackers are read-only. `recommend_tracker_edit` returns an
exact change for a coordinator to apply. Outbound Outlook and Teams tools
produce drafts with `requireConfirmation: true`; this scaffold contains
no execute/send tool. The graph pauses at `review` for coordinator
approval, and policy exceptions require HR leadership approval.

Custom MCP servers, live Workday/Microsoft connectors, Gemini Enterprise
registration, scheduling, and Model Armor are post-scaffold design work.
